artworks.title: Sonia
artworks.artist: Walter Gramatté
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a series of curved and angular lines intertwining with bold vertical and horizontal strokes, creating an abstract composition. A figure resembling a human face in profile is central to the artwork, with fingers spread out as though covering the face. The lines around the figure add a sense of motion or turbulence, akin to swirling backgrounds or flowing hair. The scene is sketch-like, with exaggerated features and a sense of spontaneity seen in the hand-drawn lines.

artworks.title: The Couple (Das Paar)
artworks.artist: Walter Gramatté
artworks.medium: etching and abrasion in blue-green on japan paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two overlapping figures, focusing on their facial features. The figure on the right shows a full face and part of the upper body, facing front. The face has large eyes and textured hair. The attire appears to be a textured garment. Beside them, a figure in profile faces left with a distinct nose and chin. The figure has wave-like hair or a beard. The background is textured with a teal band horizontally across the image. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The composition emphasizes patterns and textures.

artworks.title: Three People in an Atelier
artworks.artist: Walter Gramatté
artworks.description: The image has three figures. The figure on the left is reclined, showing the upper torso, legs, and feet. Their facial features are simple, with a straight nose, closed eyes, and a prominent hairline. The middle figure is seated with knees drawn up, hand under the chin, minimal facial features, and short hair. The third figure, next to the seated person, is seated upright with delicate facial features, a simple expression, and long hair. Two figures have sketch-like clothing, while the third appears unclothed. The background consists of sketchy, radiating lines from a source of light placed in the middle right, possibly a lamp. The image is minimalistic, with a focus on lines and shading.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.artist: Walter Gramatté
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on cream wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with their upper body visible, capturing a frontal view. The person is positioned facing the viewer directly. The facial features include deeply set eyes and a strong nose, with the expression bearing a slight smile. Their hair is dark, with a textured appearance, swept back from the forehead. The person's clothing is indistinct, appearing as a dark garment with vertical patterns. The background is composed of a dark, textured area, giving the image a monochromatic look with high contrast between the subject and the background. There is no visible jewelry or objects held by the person.

artworks.title: Qual (Torment)
artworks.artist: Walter Gramatté
artworks.medium: lithograph in black, yellow, red, and gray-green on blotting paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a stylized, abstracted figure with exaggerated facial features and large, expressive eyes. The figure appears to be situated indoors, in a setting of swirling lines and contrasting colors. The color palette is dominated by dark greens, reds, and blacks, with touches of white and yellow. The brushwork and contours present a sense of motion, with the red hue capturing attention as it contrasts against the darker shades. The sharp lines and expression contribute to a feeling of tension, suggesting an intense emotional state.

artworks.title: Performer Bowing
artworks.artist: Ernst Ludwig Kirchner
artworks.medium: color lithograph in red, black, and blue on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Collection, Gift in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This artwork shows a partial view of a woman's body from mid-thigh upwards. She appears to be in a standing or slightly leaning position, with her arms extending outward or possibly resting on something. Her facial features are stylized and prominent, with dark, arched eyebrows, a small, defined nose, and a slightly downturned mouth. Her hair is short and dark, framing her face. She is dressed in a striking red garment that fits closely to her figure. The background of the image is abstract, featuring patches of blue and red.

artworks.title: The Blond Painter Stirner
artworks.artist: Ernst Ludwig Kirchner
artworks.medium: color woodcut with monotype wiping on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Collection, Gift in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an individual with abstract and geometric facial features, prominent eyes, and a swirling, carved pattern for hair. No clothing or accessories are visible. Two abstract figures are on either side of the central person. The background is a deep purple or maroon, framed in beige.

artworks.title: Portrait of an Abbot
artworks.artist: Claude Henri Watelet after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 18 x 12.8 cm (7 1/16 x 5 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile of a man seated and facing right. He has distinct facial features, curly hair, and wears a cap or hood and a cloak. The background includes a circular frame with a ribbon at the top, and a blank rectangle below it. The image has an aged look with shaded figure and plain background.

artworks.title: S.C. Boutin
artworks.artist: Claude Henri Watelet after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 17.3 x 12 cm (6 13/16 x 4 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is an engraved image of a man in profile, showing his upper torso and head. The man's position is side-facing, with his gaze directed to the right. His facial features consist of a prominent nose and a slight chin, with hair styled in an 18th-century fashion. He is wearing a high-collared garment, possibly a coat or cloak, and a pronounced shoulder is visible. There are no visible signs of jewelry or accessories. The portrait is framed within a decorated round border and the background features lined patterns. At the bottom of the portrait, the name "S.C. Boutin" is inscribed.

artworks.title: Brunet de Neuilly
artworks.artist: Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 18.3 x 13.3 cm (7 3/16 x 5 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man's profile in a circular frame. The man has a prominent nose, closed mouth, and styled hair typical of the 18th century. He is in formal attire with a visible collar and ruffled lapel. Above the frame is a decorative ribbon or bow. The background within the frame is textured and the area outside features engraved patterns. Below the portrait is the name "I.F.A. BRUNET DE NEUILLY" engraved.

artworks.title: J. D'Alembert
artworks.artist: Claude Henri Watelet after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 17.3 x 12.5 cm (6 13/16 x 4 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a profile view of a man's head and upper shoulders within an ornate circular border. The man faces left, with detailed facial features, including a pronounced nose, full lips, and a calm expression. He has curly hair tied in a bow at the back, typical of 18th-century style. He wears a high-collared garment with intricate folds. The background has fine texture. Above the frame is a detailed decorative bow. The name "J. D'ALEMBERT" is inscribed below the portrait.

artworks.title: J. Gosseaume
artworks.artist: Louis-Jacques Cathelin after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 9.8 x 9 cm (3 7/8 x 3 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man in profile. He has a prominent nose, a strong chin, neutral expression, and pulled-back hair with a bow at the back. He wears formal attire with a high-collared shirt, coat, and a ruffled cravat. The background has decorative concentric circles framing his profile, and the top of the frame reads "J. Gossau." The engraving is signed "C.N. Cochin del 1781 L.W. Cathelin."

artworks.title: Edme-Sebastien Jeaurat
artworks.artist: Pierre Francois Martenasie after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 18.2 x 13.8 cm (7 3/16 x 5 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait featuring the upper part of a man's body, primarily focusing on his head and shoulders in profile. The man is positioned to the right, showcasing his right profile. His facial features include a broad forehead, slightly prominent nose, and closed lips, framed by tightly curled, voluminous hair that extends down to the back of his neck in an 18th-century style. He is dressed in formal attire, which includes a high-collared shirt and layered coat or robe typical of the period's fashion. The clothing suggests formality appropriate for a person of potential standing or importance. A ribbon decorates the top of the oval frame encircling the portrait. The background features a detailed hatching pattern for texture and contrast. At the bottom of the image is the name "E. JEAURAT" alongside his academic affiliations, providing clarity on the subject's identity.

artworks.title: Louis Cesar de La Baume-le-Blanc
artworks.artist: Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 17.6 x 11.2 cm (6 15/16 x 4 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraving of a male figure, displaying the upper portion of his body, including his chest, shoulders, and head. He is in a side profile, looking slightly to his left. The man has distinct facial features, a notable nose and lips, and open eyes gazing into the distance. He has voluminous 18th-century hairstyle with curls sweeping back, a tied bow around his neck, and formal clothing with a large star-shaped decoration or medallion on his chest. The background features crosshatched shading within an oval frame, encircled by another circular border. Text below the portrait provides the individual's name, titles, birth and death dates: "LOUIS CESAR DE LA BAUME-LE-BLANC, DUC DE LA VALLIERE," "Né le 9 Octobre 1708. Mort le 10 Novembre 1780."

artworks.title: Louis Cesar de La Baume-le-Blanc
artworks.artist: Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man in a three-quarter view facing slightly to the right. He has distinct facial features, curly hair styled away from his face, and is dressed in formal attire with a high-collared coat and a star decoration on his chest. The portrait is framed in an ornate circular frame with a bow at the top, set against a textured background. A decorative panel below the image includes text.

artworks.title: Jean Denis L'Empereur
artworks.artist: Pierre Gonord after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 18.8 x 13.6 cm (7 3/8 x 5 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a profile view of a person's head and shoulders in an oval frame. The individual faces to the right, displaying their side profile with distinct facial features, including a pronounced nose and slightly furrowed brow. The person has curly hair cascading down to their shoulders and wears a garment with a prominent collar. The background is grayish, and there is a decorative bow at the top of the oval frame. Below the portrait is text that reads "JEAN DENIS L'EMPEREUR" with additional descriptions and details about the engraving from 1761.

artworks.title: Jean Monnet
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 18.3 x 11.8 cm (7 3/16 x 4 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man's profile, displaying him from the shoulders up in a side view within an oval frame. The man faces right with detailed facial features, including a prominent nose and a calm expression. His hair is styled traditionally with wavy strands, possibly tied back. He wears clothing typical of the 18th century, including a jacket with visible buttons. The oval frame is decorated with floral motifs, a ribbon, and an inscription reading "Luge et Monet," as well as classical embellishments and foliage. The background features intricate lines and patterns.

artworks.title: Francois de Regny
artworks.artist: after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a person in profile facing left. The individual is seated or standing still, with their upper torso visible. Their facial features include a straight nose and slightly pointed chin, defined eyebrows, and tightly curled hair styled back. The person is wearing period clothing with a structured coat and high-collared shirt. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background features an oval frame with shading, embellished with a draped ribbon above. Text with the person's name and title is at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: J. Trevilliers
artworks.artist: Louis-Jacques Cathelin after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man in profile. He has a pronounced nose and chin, with neatly styled hair tied back. He wears a formal coat with a high collar and a frilled shirt. The engraving is circular with a textured background and decorative border. Text at the top identifies the subject as J.B.C.G. TREVILLIERS, and text at the bottom credits the artists involved.

artworks.title: Jean-Charles-Philibert Trudaine
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man in profile view, facing left. The man has distinctive facial features, including a prominent nose and chin, and elaborately styled hair typical of the 18th century. He is dressed in formal attire, with a coat and lace collar. The portrait is in an oval frame with a decorative bow at the top. The background has intricate cross-hatching. The text below the frame reads "J. CH. PH. TRUDAINE."

artworks.title: Carle Vanloo
artworks.artist: Jean Daullé after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust illustration of a man named Carlo Vanloo. He is shown in profile, facing to the right, with distinct facial features including a prominent nose, full cheek, and rounded chin. His wavy hair is tied back with a ribbon. He wears a formal garment with a high collar and potential ornate detail at the front. The portrait is surrounded by a circular border with a decorative ribbon bow at the top. The background has vertical engraved lines, and the name "CARLO VANLOO" is inscribed below the portrait. The design is monochromatic, emphasizing the classic engraved style.

artworks.title: Claude Joseph Vernet
artworks.artist: Benedict Alphonse Nicolet after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man facing left in profile. He has distinct facial features including a strong nose and a focused gaze. His hair is styled with curls and a ribbon tied at the back. He is wearing formal attire with a high collar and possibly a cravat or ruffled necktie. The background has a circular medallion frame with a decorative bow at the top and text identifying the man as Joseph Vernet and his affiliations.

artworks.title: N. Beaujeon
artworks.artist: Thérèse-Éléonore Lingée after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.dimensions: plate (trimmed to plate mark): 26.1 × 18 cm (10 1/4 × 7 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man sitting in a frontal position. He has a round face, smooth complexion, slight smile, and relaxed eyes. His hair is styled in waves, possibly powdered or white, tied back in an 18th-century fashion. He wears a high-collared jacket with ornate buttons, a cravat, and a lace shirt visible at the sleeves and collar. His right hand rests on a surface or object, potentially a piece of paper. The background features a rectangular frame around the portrait, which likely is printed on paper. A plaque under the portrait likely contains text about the person depicted.

artworks.title: Dedication Page with Statue of Fama
artworks.artist: Ercole Bazicaluva
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical statue and scenic landscape. The drawing shows a winged figure blowing a trumpet, standing on a grand monument structure with inscriptions below. The monument has decorative elements and a heraldic emblem. In the background, there is a pastoral landscape with a river, trees, and architectural structures. The sky above has wispy clouds.
